title: Odile and the Ghost
author: Kestrel Marchetti
blurb: Lior Marchetti, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
